automation_levels.full: The check is the clause's automated enforcement; a pass is the clause's evidence.
automation_levels.partial: The check proves one observable facet of the clause; the rest needs the manual or human review the clause names.

checks.name: MIT License
checks.limits: Assumes MIT while the Pro tier permits proprietary source; a proprietary licence records this as a known platform inconsistency, not an app defect.

checks.name: No .env.production
checks.limits: Only the one file name; keys in source, in VITE_* variables, or in other .env files are not detected.

checks.name: No template placeholders
checks.limits: Detects the literal APPNAME token only.

checks.name: No tracking SDKs
checks.limits: A fixed list of known trackers; a self-hosted or unlisted tracker is not detected.

checks.name: Brand fonts present
checks.limits: Presence of the font names in CSS/HTML; not that they are actually applied.

checks.name: Brand tokens defined
checks.limits: That the canonical tokens are defined; not that the app uses them instead of hard-coded colours.

checks.name: No brand overrides
checks.limits: Brand colour-token redefinitions only; the banned alias names themselves are caught by the platform design-system lint, not here. Fonts are no longer checked: the font rule has to stay for FAS (Free App Store), because those store apps need to look consistent with each other, but PAS (ProAppStore) doesn't — every app is different, so apps may use their own licensed fonts.

checks.name: CSS discipline
checks.limits: Stylesheets of apps that depend on Tailwind (ADR-011): banned token aliases, unlayered rules, hex colours outside the token blocks and hand-written class selectors. Not that components are used or that the utilities are on token colours. A warning until the fleet rollout (#495).

checks.name: No scroll (games only)
checks.limits: Games only; static CSS anti-patterns. Real document scroll is measured only in a browser.

checks.name: Viewport support
checks.limits: That orientation and min_viewport_width are declared; not that the layout works at that width.

checks.name: No unsafe 100vh
checks.limits: 100vh in source only; safe-area padding and the iOS first-load scroll need a device.

checks.name: Accessibility static
checks.limits: Missing alt text, unnamed buttons and unlabeled text controls only. Contrast, focus order, keyboard traps and rendered ARIA need a browser and a person (PAS-UI-005, 006, 023).

checks.name: HTML meta tags
checks.limits: Presence of lang, viewport, title and preview images; not the viewport's content (user-scalable=no is PAS-UI-007, a manual check).

checks.name: PWA meta tags
checks.limits: The iOS install metas only; install behaviour is verified on a device.

checks.name: PWA offline correctness
checks.limits: That a service worker is registered and the workbox config is sane; not that /.pas/* or authenticated responses stay uncached at runtime.

checks.name: PWA manifest
checks.limits: The four required fields; the rest of the manifest is reviewed manually.

checks.name: PWA maskable icon
checks.limits: Declaration only; the icon's safe zone is not rendered.

checks.name: Dark mode support
checks.limits: Warn-only signal detection; the storage-key split (fas:theme vs stores-theme) and dark-scheme contrast are manual.

checks.name: Bundle size
checks.limits: Warns when web/dist is unbuilt; measures the largest JS chunk only.

checks.name: CLAUDE.md is slim (no platform boilerplate)
checks.limits: Documentation hygiene of the scaffold's agent guide; warn-only and not a security signal.

checks.name: Unscoped actions approved
checks.limits: Reads mcp.json only: personal data is judged by output column names, and approval proves a review was recorded, not that it was sound. Without the registry it cannot tell a grandfathered action from a new one, so it warns where registration may refuse.

checks.name: Deploy workflow
checks.limits: Warn-only (#427): pattern match on .github/workflows for the reusable-pipeline caller and for wrangler, the Workers scripts API, platform Worker names and platform secrets; not what a workflow does at run time.

checks.name: Permissions declared
checks.limits: Warn-only (#437): static pattern detection of browser permission APIs in app source, compared with mcp.json permissions; dynamic or minified-away calls are not seen.

checks.name: Billing products
checks.limits: Reads mcp.json only (#507): the products and the authorize_action contract are validated, not that the action's SQL really enforces who may buy.

checks.name: Template default icon
checks.limits: Warn-only (#505): byte-matches web/public/icon-192.png and icon-512.png against the icons the template has shipped; a custom icon, or no icon, is never flagged.

checks.name: Reachable
checks.limits: HTTP 200 from the live URL; not that the app works (that is the post-deploy smoke).

checks.name: Brand fonts (live)
checks.limits: The fonts link in the served HTML only.

checks.name: Bundle size (live)
checks.limits: HEAD size of the main bundle only.

checks.name: PWA manifest (live)
checks.limits: Manifest reachable and minimally valid.

checks.name: No tracking SDKs (live)
checks.limits: Known trackers in the served HTML and fetched scripts only.

checks.name: No unsafe 100vh (live)
checks.limits: Served CSS text only.
